start.title: Connect the marketplace
start.lead: Three steps. Add the marketplace as a source first, then install the plugins you need.
start.add.title: Add the marketplace
start.add.text: Registers this catalog's repository in your Claude Code. Once per machine.
start.install.title: Install a plugin
start.install.text: Install a plugin by name from this marketplace. Its dependencies are installed with it.
start.update.title: Keep it up to date
start.update.text: Refresh the catalog, then update the plugin itself. Run /reload-plugins in an open session.
start.diff.title: marketplace update vs plugin update.
start.diff.text: The first refreshes the catalog: which plugins and versions exist. The second updates the code of one installed plugin to the newest version the catalog lists. Claude Code updates a plugin only when its version changes.
start.auto.title: Turn on auto-update.
start.auto.text: It is off by default for this marketplace. In Claude Code open /plugin → Marketplaces → {marketplace} → Enable auto-update.
